# Outfit font
Copyright 2021 The Outfit Project Authors (https://github.com/Outfitio/Outfit-Fonts), SIL Open Font License 1.1
(see `OFL-LICENSE.txt`). Source: npm package `@fontsource/outfit` 5.2.8 (latin subset, weights 400/600/700),
converted from WOFF2 to TTF with fontTools (no other change). Bundled in `app/src/main/res/font/`.
Latin subset has no "∑": don't use it in UI text.
